summary: Victim was persuaded over an extended period to invest through a fraudulent cryptocurrency investment platform that displayed fictitious profits and later demanded a release fee before withdrawals would be permitted. The victim remained at risk of sending additional funds due to continued trust in the scammers and the displayed account balance.
user_mistake: Trusted an online investment relationship and believed displayed profits were genuine
prevention: Verify investment platforms independently before depositing funds / Refuse requests for withdrawal fees release fees taxes or other advance payments
